title: Deploy notes for the reminder job
ask: Write DEPLOY.md for putting the nightly reminder job live on our hosting. Check hosting-plans.md, a saved copy of the host's plan page, for what our plan allows.
background: We are on the Starter plan, and I'm hoping the job can run there without paying more.
The job sends appointment reminders at 6 each evening.
It takes under a minute to run.

start.hosting-plans.md:
Hosting plans, saved copy of the host's page

Starter: scheduled jobs are not included.
Team: scheduled jobs included, up to 20.
Both plans include daily backups.
